description: Power-user escape hatch: POST to any Autumn read/preview endpoint not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — the path is validated to only allow .get / .list / .check / .preview_* actions; write actions are rejected. Autumn API: POST {path}.

body.description: JSON body object to POST (the endpoint's params).

path.description: Full API path, e.g. "/v1/customers.get". Only read/preview suffixes are allowed.

name: autumn_request
title: Raw read request
